senses.gloss: (b. h. שָׂקַר) [to blink, shine; denom. סִיקְרָא]

units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 3:2:7">Y. Nidd. III, 50ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>סוֹקְרִין לפניהן כאדם</he> they look forward (have their eyes in front of the head) like human beings (v. Bab.

senses.gloss: (denom. of סִיקְרָא) to paint red, mark with siḳra.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 9:7">Bekh. IX, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Bekhorot 58b:4">58ᵇ</cite>) <he>היוצא … סוֹקְרוֹ בסיקרא</he> (Talm. ed. <he>סוֹקֵר</he>) he marks every tenth lamb that goes forth; <cite ref="Bekhorot 58b:4">ib.</cite> <he>לא סְקָרוֹ וכ׳</he> (Talm. ed. <he>סוקרו</he>) if he failed to mark it.
<cite ref="Shabbat 67a:15">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>סוקרו בסיקרא</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50); <cite ref="Chullin 77b">Ḥull. 77ᵇ</cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to paint (the eyes). Pesik. Vattom. p. 132ᵃ (ref. to Is. III, 16) שהיו מְסַקְּרוֹת וכ׳ Ar. (ed. סוֹקְרוֹת) they painted their eyes with siḳra; Lam. R. to IV, 15 מְשַׂקְּרוֹת; Lev. R. s. 16; Yalk. Lam. 1030 מְשַׂקֶּרֶת עיניה וכ׳ (not משקרות) she painted her eyes &c.

units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 18a:14">R. Hash. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>כולן נִסְקָרִין בסקירה אחת</he> they are all reviewed with one glance; v. <cite ref="G00655"><he>זָקַר</he></cite>.
